description: This file defines a MailgunService class for initializing Mailgun client and provides a function to send emails using templates, handling various email types for an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: MailgunService
classes.description: A class to initialize and manage Mailgun client connection using API keys and domain.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new Mailgun client instance with provided API key and domain.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Asynchronously sends an email with specified recipient, type, host, and data, using templates for message content.

methods.name: prepareTemplate
methods.description: Prepares email message content based on the email type, host, and data, selecting the appropriate template.
